description: Disposition of every supported cell in the Advisor method x target matrix. Section 8 of docs/sql-server-to-azure-migration.md marks 51 (method, target) cells as supported. Each one must appear here exactly once with a status, so that a route the Advisor can recommend can never silently lack prerequisite coverage. Enforced by tests/check-prerequisite-skill.mjs.

statuses.path: Covered by one or more prerequisite paths in this catalog.
statuses.out-of-scope: Deliberately excluded. The reason must explain why this cell is not a SQL Server to Azure data-movement route.
statuses.deferred: Acknowledged gap. The method already exists in the catalog on other targets; closing this cell means widening an existing path's applicability, not adding a new one. The reason must name that path.

dispositions.reason: Azure Migrate appears in this matrix row as an assessment and business-case control plane, not a data-movement method. Its assessment prerequisites are common prerequisites. The Azure Migrate replication method is a distinct route covered by P06.
Assessment control plane, not a data-movement method. AVS data movement is covered by P07.

SQL Server hosted on an Azure VMware Solution VM is a self-managed instance, so the restore mechanics match P04. Closing this cell means widening P04 applicability to the AVS-hosted target and adding the AVS-specific network and storage conditions, not creating a new path.

Extending an availability group to a replica hosted on Azure VMware Solution reuses the P01 and P02 prerequisite set plus AVS-specific quorum, latency and network conditions. Closing this cell means widening P01 and P02 applicability.
P13 is already a multi-target path. Closing this cell means adding the SQL Server on Azure VM subscriber to P13 applicability with its target-specific conditions.
